passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My home is a small house in Seoul.
phrases.ko: 나의 집은 서울에 있는 작은 주택이에요.
phrases.zh: 我的家是首尔的一所小房子。
phrases.py: wǒ de jiā shì shǒu ěr de yī suǒ xiǎo fáng zi。

phrases.en: It has a warm kitchen and a bright living room.
phrases.zh: 它有温暖的厨房和明亮的客厅。
phrases.py: tā yǒu wēn nuǎn de chú fáng hé míng liàng de kè tīng。

phrases.en: The sun comes in the window.
phrases.py: yáng guāng cóng chuāng hù jìn lái。

phrases.en: My room is clean, and I feel safe at home.
phrases.ko: 내 방은 깨끗하고, 나는 집에서 안전해요.
phrases.zh: 我的房间很干净，我在家里觉得安全。
phrases.py: wǒ de fáng jiān hěn gān jìng， wǒ zài jiā lǐ jué de ān quán。
wǒ de jiā rén ài wǒ men de jiā。

phrases.ko: 여섯 사람이 이 집을 함께 써요.
phrases.zh: 六个人住在这所房子里。
phrases.py: liù gè rén zhù zài zhè suǒ fáng zi lǐ。

phrases.en: The living room is where we talk at night.
phrases.py: wǎn shàng wǒ men zài kè tīng shuō huà。

phrases.en: The kitchen smells warm when Mom cooks.
phrases.ko: 엄마가 요리하면 부엌에서 따뜻한 냄새가 나요.
phrases.zh: 妈妈做饭的时候，厨房有温暖的气味。
phrases.py: mā mā zuò fàn de shí hòu， chú fáng yǒu wēn nuǎn de qì wèi。

phrases.en: I keep my room clean because I like it.
phrases.ko: 나는 내 방을 좋아해서 깨끗하게 두어요.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢我的房间，所以把它保持干净。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān wǒ de fáng jiān， suǒ yǐ bǎ tā bǎo chí gān jìng。

phrases.en: A safe home is the best place to rest.
phrases.ko: 안전한 집은 쉬기에 가장 좋은 곳이에요.
phrases.zh: 安全的家是最好的休息地方。
phrases.py: ān quán de jiā shì zuì hǎo de xiū xī dì fāng。

phrases.en: I am happy when my family is home.
phrases.zh: 家人都在家的时候，我很快乐。
phrases.py: jiā rén dōu zài jiā de shí hòu， wǒ hěn kuài lè。

full_passage_spoken: My home is a small house in Seoul. It has a warm kitchen and a bright living room. The sun comes in the window. My room is clean, and I feel safe at home. My family loves our home. Six people share this house. The living room is where we talk at night. The kitchen smells warm when Mom cooks. I keep my room clean because I like it. A safe home is the best place to rest. I am happy when my family is home.
full_passage_zh: 我的家是首尔的一所小房子。它有温暖的厨房和明亮的客厅。阳光从窗户进来。我的房间很干净，我在家里觉得安全。我的家人爱我们的家。六个人住在这所房子里。晚上我们在客厅说话。妈妈做饭的时候，厨房有温暖的气味。我喜欢我的房间，所以把它保持干净。安全的家是最好的休息地方。家人都在家的时候，我很快乐。
